content.name: Ring of Elemental Command (Water)
entries: The Ring of Elemental Command (water) is linked to the Elemental Plane of Water. Every Ring of Elemental Command has the following two properties:

items.name: Elemental Bane
entries: While wearing the ring, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on attack rolls against Elementals and they have {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} on attack rolls against you.

items.name: Elemental Compulsion
entries: While wearing the ring, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to try to compel an Elemental you see within 60 feet of yourself. The Elemental makes a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the Elemental has the {@condition Charmed|SRD52} condition until the start your next turn, and you determine what it does with its move and action on its next turn.

entries.name: Elemental Focus
entries: While wearing the ring, you benefit from additional properties corresponding to the ring's linked Elemental Plane:

items.name: Water
entries: You know Aquan, you gain a {@variantrule Swim Speed|SRD52} of 60 feet, and you can breathe underwater.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: The ring has 5 charges and regains {@dice 1d4 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the ring, you can cast a spell from it. A spell cast from the ring has a save DC of 18. Choose the spell from the following list: {@spell Create or Destroy Water|SRD52} (1 charge), {@spell Ice Storm|SRD52} (2 charges), {@spell Tsunami|SRD52} (5 charges), {@spell Wall of Ice|SRD52} (3 charges), {@spell Water Walk|SRD52} (2 charges)
